title: Track core-cohort research readiness by product
objective: Every priority product has a measured route from source evidence to use.
outcome: The frozen 100-product cohort is the denominator. Annual releases of the same product do not inflate that denominator. Missing essential context remains a named blocker. Public-sample completion and restricted/manual route completion are counted separately. A thousand populated optional fields cannot compensate for an unknown essential denominator or inaccessible recipe. Every incomplete priority product has a concrete next task; the program gate cannot waive it by adding more easy records. R04/R05 remain incomplete until remaining non-public-sample products have verified manual/restricted routes. Sealed packages/coverage/accounting artifacts and evaluation/research-program/cohorts.json are not edited. Last-good generation live-2026-09-03-85b50522b420 is unchanged.

commits.subject: Join the cohort to exact contexts
commits.instructions: Resolve each product anchor to its selected releases, distributions, documentation, examples and scientific claims. Preserve manual/restricted branches.
commits.verification: Annual releases do not inflate the 100-product denominator; missing essential context remains a named blocker.

commits.subject: Compute essential readiness
commits.instructions: Evaluate mandatory source-card fields, recent sample/route success, example field semantics and evidence closure. Keep public sample and restricted route completion separate.
commits.verification: A thousand populated optional fields cannot compensate for an unknown essential denominator or inaccessible recipe.

commits.subject: Generate bounded deficit assignments
commits.instructions: For each remaining blocker, emit source/document/field scope and required evidence into the exception PR template; group only related parser/adapter causes.
commits.verification: Every incomplete priority product has a concrete next task; the program gate cannot waive it by adding more easy records.
